title: On Paper It's Fine
gist_ar: مشهد تفاوض بلغة دارجة: المقاولة بتكتشف إن المخاطرة اللي هتضرّها مش مكتوبة.

before_listening.en: A negotiation. Listen for the risk she notices that is not written anywhere.
before_listening.ar: مفاوضة. ركّز على المخاطرة اللي هي لاحظتها ومش مكتوبة في أي حاجة.

segments.speaker: Dalia
segments.text: So on paper it's fine. Twelve months, and if the permits drag, the clock stops. I've no problem with that.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: Good. It's fairly standard, to be honest. Most people sign it as is.

segments.speaker: Dalia
segments.text: Most people aren't carrying the concrete. Here's my thing. Permits drag — fine, we're covered. Milestone slips — that's your call, you can waive it or come after me, and at least I can see that coming.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: We've never enforced it. Not once.

segments.speaker: Dalia
segments.text: I believe you. It's still your call, though, isn't it. Anyway that's not what's keeping me up. What's keeping me up isn't in here at all.

segments.speaker: Dalia
segments.text: Steel. If the permits take fourteen months and my supplier's quote lapses at six, I'm eating the difference. There's nothing in this about price.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: That's — well, that's between you and your supplier, strictly speaking.

segments.speaker: Dalia
segments.text: Strictly speaking, yes. Which is a polite way of saying it lands on me. And I can't hedge it, I'm too small to hedge it, and I can't walk away in month thirteen because I'll have poured foundations.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: I hear you. I'm not sure I can get an escalation clause past the committee.

segments.speaker: Dalia
segments.text: Then let's do this. Put in writing that if the permit delay runs past nine months we sit down again. That's not money. That's a conversation.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: A review trigger. That I can probably do.

segments.speaker: Dalia
segments.text: Then we're close. Because as it stands, the only person in this room taking a risk nobody has priced is me.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: I'll take the review trigger to them on Thursday. I think it goes through.

segments.speaker: Fouad
segments.text: Then you'd be signing it as it stands, and I'd understand if you didn't sign it.

segments.speaker: Dalia
segments.text: Good. I'd rather hear that than be told it's standard one more time.

gist_question.q: What risk does she identify that the contract ignores?
options: That the permits will be refused
That her steel price will rise while she waits for permits
That the milestone penalty will be enforced

questions.q: What does 'I'm eating the difference' mean?
options: She absorbs the extra cost herself
She will cancel the contract rather than accept the steel-price risk herself
She will pass it to the supplier

questions.q: Why can she not simply walk away later?
options: She will have poured foundations by then
The contract explicitly forbids any withdrawal after the permit stage

questions.q: What does she settle for instead of a price clause?
options: A review trigger if permit delay passes nine months
